Remark
↗ thm:interior-h2-regularity 1. ch6:6.3-rem-1\group Regularity Theory

(i) No zero-trace condition is required: $u\in H^1(U)$ suffices.

(ii) Since $u\in H^2_{\mathrm{loc}}(U)$, \[ Lu = f \quad \text{a.e. in } U. \] the weak identity agrees with the distributional integration-by-parts identity.
